mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_history (user_id, question, answer) VALUES (#{userId}, #{question}, #{answer})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_history WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT q.id AS question_id, q.user_id, q.context_type, q.target_id, q.question, q.category, q.is_answered, q.answered_in_seconds, q.created_at AS question_created_at, a.id AS answer_id, a.answer, a.token_usage, a.is_successful, a.created_at AS answer_created_at FROM ai_questions q LEFT JOIN ai_answers a ON q.id = a.question_id WHERE q.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY q.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM ai_history WHERE question_id = #{questionId} LIMIT 1
